decisions.reason: A core navigation and observation camera with its own page in a growing industry likely meets aspirations, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.
The modular multi-model camera line matches the strategy of flexible, compact sensors, and slack from growth lets the firm carry it through long space sales cycles.
Space situational awareness is a growing field supported by EU funding, so organisational slack justifies keeping the suite while its results mature.

The miniaturized LiDAR builds on the firm's docking heritage and its push toward small satellites; its early, uncertain results can be absorbed by slack rather than prompting a search for other uses of the resources.
A newly launched radiation-hard camera line with its own page is close to the core offer and too young to be judged as falling short of aspirations.
The asteroid navigation camera is tied to long deep-space missions where it is only just being proven, and the firm's slack lets it wait for results rather than dropping it early.
